purpose: Record exact Mark2 motion replay with a matched prior shoulder comparator.

scope.head: Progressively checks commanded moves against deposited nominal beads and the photo-estimated stock left-active H2C assembly.
scope.contact: Estimates finite annulus and cone contact with a rigid cross section from nominal E/width/feed geometry, distinguishing fresh stock, preceding part and removable support.
scope.dry_resolution: The exact-XY witness check compares nominal previously deposited curve and width at sampled dry nozzle centers. It records whether the sample fell at a move end.
scope.limits: Startup and shutdown firmware movement, parking macros, bed compensation, actual head dimensions, stock deformation, curl, adhesion and physical fits remain outside this model.
scope.timing: Feed time includes commanded dwell and axis speed caps. Acceleration-aware playback is supplied separately by the sequencer.

candidate_reading_basis: Exact packaged motion after normalizing progress header.

mapped_deposition_flow_cap.purpose: Limit commanded volumetric flow in the rebuilt tip's linear courses.
mapped_deposition_flow_cap.scope: Compares flow at commanded feed and tightened scope from the source header filament settings.

acceleration_aware_chronology.purpose: Measure whole-plate chronology from the unsampled repository acceleration planner.
acceleration_aware_chronology.estimate_scope: Commanded motion with acceleration. Printer warmup, thermal waits, firmware macros and physical execution are outside the clock.

candidate.purpose: Compare deposited tip roads with the draining bore's unobstructed CAD core.
candidate.scope: Sampling in the nominal CAD drain cylinder. Only probes geometrically inside the rounded bead by more than .01 mm count. Path shifts, material behavior, and backlighting or flow of a physical print are separate.

prior_review.purpose: Compare deposited tip roads with the draining bore's unobstructed CAD core.
prior_review.scope: Sampling in the nominal CAD drain cylinder. Only probes geometrically inside the rounded bead by more than .01 mm count. Path shifts, material behavior, and backlighting or flow of a physical print are separate.
